glossary: PE / put option
A bet that Nifty will fall. Buying one pays if it falls; selling one pays you upfront and costs you if it falls.
CE / call option
A bet that Nifty will rise.
Lot
Nifty options trade in lots of 65 units. ₹1 of option price = ₹65 per lot.
Put spread
Sell one put, buy a cheaper one below it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
15-min candle close
Wait for the 15-minute bar on the chart to finish before acting, so one spike doesn't fool you.
Call spread
Sell one call, buy a cheaper one above it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
Iron condor
A call spread and a put spread sold together. You collect both premiums; it pays if Nifty stays between the two sold strikes, and the loss is capped.

why: The biggest bet of the day, 38,000 contracts, says Bank Nifty stays under 62,000, and it grew during the bounce; that is why a rise here is where you sell.
Big traders added 6,000 bets since 1:45 pm that it won't fall, so the floor is firmer than before; don't sell before the bounce stalls.
Big traders hold 38,500 bets that it won't fall below 61,000, so a drop usually slows there; take profit well before it.
Option prices point to a move of about 420 points either way today, so 61,800 is reachable from here; that is the take-profit.
simple.risk: Trade one lot only. ₹3,690 is the most you can lose, more than the ₹2,310 you collect, so honour the 62,400 stop. Bank Nifty moves 400 points in minutes. Paper-trade two weeks before real money.
glossary: PE / put option
A bet that Nifty will fall. Buying one pays if it falls; selling one pays you upfront and costs you if it falls.
CE / call option
A bet that Nifty will rise.
Lot
Bank Nifty options trade in lots of 30 units. ₹1 of option price = ₹30 per lot.
Put spread
Sell one put, buy a cheaper one below it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
15-min candle close
Wait for the 15-minute bar on the chart to finish before acting, so one spike doesn't fool you.
Call spread
Sell one call, buy a cheaper one above it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
